entries.text: Awarded when merchant fulfills 10 orders on LUMO
Awarded when merchant reaches 100 successful dispatches
Awarded to elite high-volume merchants
Awarded for consecutive daily order processing
Awarded for generating over 10M TZS gross revenue
Merchant registers the delivery order in the LUMO dashboard with customer phone number, delivery address, and product details.
Driver starts the delivery. The customer receives an automated SMS/WhatsApp notification with a secure web tracking link.
Driver approaches the customer location and updates status to Arrived. Customer gets a reminder to prepare for handover.
Package is handed over using 4-digit PIN verification code. Status updates to Delivered in real-time.
Do my customers need to download an application to track their delivery?

No! LUMO Track is 100% web-based. Customers receive an SMS or WhatsApp message containing a secure link. Tapping the link opens the live delivery tracking portal instantly in their phone browser without installing any app.
Do my drivers need to install an app to update delivery status?
No. Drivers receive a lightweight action web link on their mobile phone. They can tap "Start Delivery", "Arrived", or enter the customer PIN code right from their phone browser.
How do customer SMS notifications work in Tanzania?
LUMO Track integrates with local telecom networks in Tanzania (Vodacom, Tigo, Airtel, Halotel). Whenever an order is created or status changes, an automated SMS is dispatched to the customer.
Can I display my business logo and shop branding on tracking pages?
Yes! Every merchant profile includes custom branding settings. Your shop name, logo, phone number, and brand color will appear prominently on your customer tracking portal.
How does 4-digit PIN delivery verification work?

When an order is created, the customer receives a unique 4-digit PIN via SMS. Upon arrival, the driver asks the customer for the PIN and enters it into the portal to confirm handover, preventing disputes.
Merchant registers order in the LUMO dashboard with customer phone number, delivery destination address, and driver assignment.
System dispatches automated SMS/WhatsApp message containing the customer’s unique, secure web tracking link.
Driver opens browser action link on their phone and taps "Start Delivery", updating order status to On the Way.
Customer opens their web portal link to view live delivery timeline, driver name, and merchant contact options without an app.
Driver verifies handover using 4-digit PIN code. Status changes to Delivered, sending confirmation receipt to merchant and buyer.
Ideal for small social sellers and new merchants starting delivery notifications.
